title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework.
* Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews.
* Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear.
* Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging.
* Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory.
* Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM.
* Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects.
* Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area.
* Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation.
* Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time.

**Nice to Have**

* Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling.
* Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath.
* Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal.
* Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service.
* Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

**Impact**
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, and MongoDB.
* Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits.
* Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2.0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2.0 and other enterprise authentication schemes.
* Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS.
* Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs.
* Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases.
* Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD.
* AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security.
* Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations.

****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our mission is to enable effective financial decisions through reliable data, increased efficiency, and automation. We support Marketing, Sales, Seller, Accounting, Tax, Finance and Strategy (F&S), Finance Operations (FinOps), and Treasury functions across automation, data insights, and process improvements.
  
  
You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including
  
  
Seller Systems — Responsible for building the systems and tooling that make sellers and internal revenue teams at Stripe dramatically more productive and effective. We partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to deliver a single "plane of glass" selling experience that spans deal creation and modeling, negotiation and approvals, contracting, onboarding, and activation. The Finance Engineering team is at the core of Stripe to empower business-critical financial domains including Accounting, Finance operations, Finance and Strategy, and Treasury. Engineers on the Financial Engineering team build platforms, data pipelines, and financial products for the Finance team. The use cases include financial analytics and insights, accounting automation, auditing, financial planning and forecasting, and financial business intelligence.

We do this through scalable motions, with the most relevant messaging and increasing reach of our marketing motions. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, analysts, marketers, and product managers that deliver the insights, internal systems and tools that fuel growth at Stripe.
  
  
As part of the Marketing Systems team, you own systems that power go-to-market motions productizing gathered insights and intelligence. title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
About the role

Recruitcha.ai is sales intelligence for recruitment agencies. We watch the market for hiring signals so agency recruiters know which companies to call, who to talk to, and why now. Our products include Jobs Listener, Social Listener, ATS Graveyard and Market Mapping.

We're three people. We're bootstrapped and profitable, with 100+ agencies using our platform. The founders spent 10+ years running and selling into recruiting agencies, so we already know what our customers need. Our job is to build it well.

We built the first version fast, using AI heavily. It works, and customers pay for it. Some of it is held together with duct tape. We're hiring our first engineer to turn it into a platform that scales without losing the speed that got us here.

At a glance

**Location**
: Remote, with 2+ hours of daily overlap with US PST time

**Team**
: 3 people today; you'd be the first engineer

**Reports to:**
The founders

What you'll own

You'll decide what to refactor, what to rebuild, and what to leave alone. Here are the problems on the table today:

* **Signal ingestion.**
  We pull hiring signals from job boards, ATS pages, social activity and third-party data providers. Much of it runs on scheduled jobs that fail silently. It needs to become a reliable pipeline with monitoring, retries and deduplication.
* **Data model at scale.**
  Companies, contacts, jobs and signals have grown faster than our Supabase schema was designed for. Queries are slowing down and the data has duplicates.
* **Agentic workflows.**
  Our AI agents research accounts, find decision-makers and draft outreach. They work well in demos. Before we can trust them across every customer, they need evals, guardrails, cost controls and observability.
* **Engineering foundations.**
  We need CI, tests where they matter, staging environments, and a deploy process that doesn't depend on luck.
* **New product.**
  Customers ask for features every week. You'll work with the founders to decide what to build and then ship it across the full stack.

Your first 90 days

1. **By day 30:**
   You've shipped to production, sat in on customer calls, and mapped the codebase. You've told us what's fragile and what's fine.
2. **By day 60:**
   You've fixed the worst reliability problem, likely signal ingestion. Failures now alert someone instead of disappearing.
3. **By day 90:**
   You own deploys, monitoring and the technical roadmap. You're shipping customer features every week, and we make architecture decisions based on your judgment.

Our stack

* **Frontend:**
  Next.js, TypeScript
* **Backend:**
  Node.js, Python, Supabase (Postgres)
* **AI:**
  model providers, e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google

You don't need experience with all of these. We want a strong engineer first, and the stack can change if you make the case.

You'll probably be a great fit if you've

* Taken a prototype or MVP to production and kept it running under real customer load
* Owned features end to end, from the database to the UI
* Inherited a messy codebase and improved it without stopping to rewrite everything
* Built data pipelines, scrapers or integrations that had to be reliable
* Shipped something with LLMs that ran in production, beyond a demo
* Worked as a founding engineer, an early startup engineer, or a senior full-stack engineer

This probably isn't the role for you if you want

* Detailed specs before you start building
* A large engineering team to learn from
* A frontend-only or backend-only role
* Someone else to make the technical decisions

How we work

We're remote and open to great people anywhere. You'll need at least 3 hours of overlap each workday with the founders, who work on US PST time. During that overlap we talk directly with you, not through tickets. The rest of your day is yours to plan.

We care about clear communication, ownership, and what you ship. Priorities shift as customers teach us things, and you'll help decide what comes next.

Hiring process

We aim to go from first call to offer in about [2 to 3] weeks.

1. **Intro call (30 min)**
   with a founder about the role, the business, and what you want next.
2. **Technical conversation (60 min):**
   we walk through our architecture together and ask how you'd approach one of the problems above.
3. **Paid trial project:**
   a small, real piece of work in our codebase.
4. **Founder conversations,**
   then an offer.

**Join the RISC-V Revolution!**
**About GlobalFoundries**
GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. We are seeking a highly skilled Sr Staff Engineer in AI/ML compiler and runtime software to join our Platform Software and AI SDK team. The team is building the foundational software stack to enable Physical AI workloads on next-generation RISC-V IP and SoC platforms.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of AI compiler technology, edge AI deployment, runtime systems, and hardware acceleration. You will work on IREE-based compiler and runtime flows, LLVM/MLIR infrastructure, custom MLIR dialects and passes, code generation, quantization, and NPU acceleration to enable efficient execution of AI models on edge devices and silicon platforms.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to contribute across the full silicon-to-software lifecycle, combining compiler engineering, AI runtime development, and hardware-software co-design to deliver high-performance, low-latency, and power-efficient AI execution for real-time edge and Physical AI use cases.

* Optimize neural network workloads for edge deployment, including operator fusion, tiling, memory planning, quantization, layout transformation, and accelerator-aware scheduling.
* Enable efficient execution of AI models across CPU, vector, matrix, and NPU acceleration paths, balancing latency, throughput, memory footprint, and power efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with architecture, hardware, firmware, FPGA, validation, and product teams to bring up AI workloads on simulators, FPGA platforms, emulation environments, and silicon.
* Analyze model performance, identify compiler/runtime bottlenecks, and drive optimizations across graph-level, operator-level, and kernel-level execution paths.
* Define software architecture and technical direction for AI SDK components, including compiler pipelines, runtime interfaces, model deployment flows, and accelerator integration.
* Build test infrastructure, validation flows, benchmark suites, and CI pipelines for AI compiler/runtime correctness, performance, and regression tracking.
* Provide technical leadership to engineers working on AI compiler, runtime, model deployment, and edge AI software development.
* Work with internal and customer-facing teams to support software enablement, debugging, performance tuning, and deployment of AI workloads on target platforms.

**Ideally, you’ll have**

* 1-4 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong experience in compiler, runtime, embedded software, or AI/ML systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with IREE, LLVM, and MLIR compiler infrastructure. Experience developing MLIR dialects, compiler passes, lowering pipelines, pattern rewrites, code generation flows, or backend integration for custom hardware.
* Good understanding of IREE code generation flow, dispatch formation, executable generation, HAL/runtime concepts, and target-specific lowering.
* Strong exposure to AI compiler/runtime stacks used for edge AI or accelerator-backed inference.

* Strong understanding of neural network execution and optimization, including quantization, operator fusion, tensor layouts, memory planning, tiling, vectorization, and kernel selection.
* Experience enabling or optimizing workloads for AI accelerators, NPUs, DSPs, vector processors, matrix engines, or custom SoC IP.
* Strong C/C++ programming skills, with good Python scripting ability for compiler tooling, testing, automation, and model workflow integration.
* Experience working in Linux development environments, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, build systems, and runtime bring-up.Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across compiler IR, generated code, runtime behavior, and hardware/software interaction.
* Ability to work with architecture and hardware teams to understand accelerator capabilities and translate them into compiler/runtime enablement.

* Experience with edge AI deployment on real devices, development boards, FPGA platforms, emulators, simulators, or early silicon.

* Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We're looking for a Senior Staff SDET to set the technical direction for test engineering across our Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) products. You'll be a hands-on technical leader. You'll design and build scalable test frameworks and infrastructure, influence product architecture for testability, and raise engineering quality standards across several teams.
  
  
You'll work closely with Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Product leadership so we can ship reliable, secure, high-performance identity solutions to enterprise customers at speed.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test architecture: Define and own the test architecture and automation strategy for the IGA platform, spanning unit, API, contract, integration, UI, and end-to-end testing.
  
  
Frameworks and infrastructure: Design, build, and evolve reusable test frameworks, tools, and test environments that scale across teams and microservices.
  
  
CI/CD quality gates: Embed automated testing deep into CI/CD pipelines. Push for fast, reliable feedback, parallel execution, and fewer flaky tests.
  
  
Domain test coverage: Lead test design for complex IGA flows, including:
  
  
Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver)
  
  
Provisioning and deprovisioning
  
  
Access requests and approvals
  
  
Certification campaigns
  
  
Connectors to systems such as Active Directory, Entra ID, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, and SaaS apps
  
  
Technical leadership: Act as the senior technical authority on quality. Review designs and code, mentor SDETs and developers, and set best practices and standards across the division.
  
  
Shift-left and developer productivity: Partner with development teams to improve testability, contract testing, mocking and service virtualization, and test data management.
  
  
Observability and metrics: Define quality metrics and dashboards such as coverage, flakiness, defect leakage, and pipeline health, and use the data to drive decisions.
  
  
Innovation: Evaluate and introduce new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted testing, test impact analysis, and chaos engineering.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
8 or more years in software engineering or test engineering
  
  
Strong coding skills in one or more of Java, C#, Python, TypeScript, or Go, with solid software design principles.
  
  
Deep experience building automation frameworks with tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, REST Assured, Pact, TestNG/JUnit, or pytest.
  
  
Excellent communication skills and a track record of mentoring engineers.
  
  
Experience with IAM or IGA platforms (for example SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, One Identity, or Microsoft Entra).

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Customer Solutions Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineering
description:
Customer Solutions Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineering

Company: KAVIA AI

Location: India — Remote

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering

Experience: 4–8 years

Compensation: INR 20,00,000 to INR 28,00,000 annual CTC, based on background, experience, and demonstrated customer-facing technical ownership

About KAVIA AI

KAVIA AI is an enterprise software company building the enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases.

We help engineering teams understand, plan, change, and validate large software systems. KAVIA connects code understanding, workflow automation, artifact generation, reviewable code, and validation across repositories and environments.

Our platform is used by enterprise teams working on consequential software systems. As KAVIA’s product and customer footprint grow, we are expanding the customer engineering capability that turns difficult technical use cases into successful pilots and production adoption.

The Role

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role at a growing enterprise software company. At KAVIA, the Customer Solutions Engineer serves as a Forward Deployed Engineer: part software engineer, part technical problem solver, and part pilot owner.

Reporting to KAVIA’s Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering, you will work closely with enterprise engineering customers, KAVIA’s product and engineering teams, and company leadership. You will understand a customer’s codebase and operating constraints, demonstrate KAVIA against the right problem, translate that problem into a tightly scoped pilot, and stay accountable through technical validation.

Success in this role is not measured by the number of demos delivered. It is measured by whether KAVIA earns technical confidence: the right problem is selected, the evaluation is credible, blockers are resolved, results are documented, and the customer can make an informed production decision.

This is not a conventional sales-engineering role built around standard demonstrations, and it is not a support role limited to routing issues. You must be comfortable reading unfamiliar code, working directly in technical environments, and communicating clearly with both engineers and senior stakeholders. The role requires regular overlap with US and European business hours and may include occasional customer travel.

What You’ll Do

Lead Technical Discovery

* Run structured discovery with engineering leaders, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Understand the customer’s codebase, architecture, repositories, build and test systems, development workflow, constraints, and desired outcome.
* Separate the stated request from the underlying engineering problem, and identify where KAVIA can create measurable value.
* Surface dependencies, security or deployment requirements, data-access constraints, technical risks, and decision criteria early.
* Determine whether an opportunity is technically ready for a demonstration or pilot, and say so clearly when it is not.

Prepare and Deliver Tailored Demonstrations

* Design demonstrations around the customer’s actual use case rather than rely on a generic product walkthrough.
* Select representative code, workflows, and evidence that make KAVIA’s value understandable and technically credible.
* Configure and test the demonstration environment, anticipate likely questions, and prepare recovery paths when live systems behave unexpectedly.
* Explain KAVIA’s reasoning, outputs, limitations, and deployment options with precision and without overclaiming.
* Capture questions and objections, follow up with clear technical answers, and identify what must be proven next.

Convert Use Cases into Well-Scoped Pilots

* Translate discovery into a concise pilot definition with a clear problem statement, scope, inputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Define success measures that compare KAVIA-assisted work with the customer’s current process, including time, effort, quality, completeness, or validation outcomes where appropriate.
* Keep pilots narrow enough to execute quickly while meaningful enough to support a purchase or deployment decision.
* Align customer and internal stakeholders on what is in scope, what is not, and what evidence will constitute success before work begins.

Own Pilot Execution and Resolve Technical Blockers

* Serve as the technical owner for assigned pilots from kickoff through final validation.
* Work directly with repositories, manifests, branches, build systems, APIs, development environments, and deployment configurations as required by the engagement.
* Use KAVIA hands-on to investigate the customer’s problem, generate or review outputs, and validate results against agreed criteria.
* Diagnose blockers, distinguish product issues from environment or integration issues, and coordinate the right engineering response without losing momentum.
* Maintain a clear execution plan, technical decision log, risk list, and next action for every active pilot.
* Escalate product gaps and delivery risks early, with enough evidence for engineering and leadership to act.

Move Customers to Technical Validation

* Design and run the final validation against the agreed acceptance criteria, including build, test, review, or workflow evidence where applicable.
* Present results honestly, including what worked, what remains unresolved, and what would be required for production use.
* Quantify before-and-after outcomes when the evidence supports them and avoid unsupported or inflated claims.
* Produce the technical readout, recommendations, open issues, and proposed next step needed for the customer and KAVIA to make a decision.
* Support the transition from successful pilot to deployment, expansion, or a clearly defined follow-on phase.

Turn Customer Learning into Reusable Assets

* Write concise technical follow-ups, solution notes, pilot plans, validation summaries, runbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Contribute credible technical evidence and approved results to case studies, sales collateral, product documentation, and enablement material.
* Convert repeated customer patterns into reusable demo assets, pilot templates, checklists, and internal playbooks.
* Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering, distinguishing one-off requests from broadly valuable product improvements.
* Help improve KAVIA’s customer-engineering methods as the company builds a repeatable enterprise adoption motion.

What We’re Looking For

Required

* 4–8 years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or forward deployment engineering experience, with substantial hands-on technical ownership.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and production experience in at least one widely used programming language such as Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, or C++.
* Ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, form a useful system model, trace dependencies, diagnose failures, and make progress without a fully specified playbook.
* Working knowledge of Git-based development, APIs, build and test workflows, CI/CD, containers, cloud or on-premises environments, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, implementations, or similarly bounded customer engagements.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous customer problem into a clear technical plan, measurable success criteria, and disciplined execution.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to engineers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment under pressure, intellectual honesty about product limitations, and the confidence to challenge an unworkable scope or unsupported claim.
* Strong project ownership, including action tracking, risk management, documentation, follow-through, and timely escalation.
* Ability to maintain dependable overlap with US or European business hours when customer meetings and pilot execution require it.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities change, processes are still being built, and customer outcomes matter more than role boundaries.

Strong Plus

* Experience with enterprise developer tools, AI-assisted software engineering, code intelligence, software modernization, testing, or engineering productivity platforms.
* Experience with complex brownfield systems, multi-repository codebases, embedded Linux, Android, Yocto, RDK, OpenWrt, automotive software, telecom software, or similar platform environments.
* Experience designing secure enterprise deployments, including customer-controlled cloud, self-hosted, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments.
* Experience working with large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or evaluation frameworks.
* Experience gathering defensible before-and-after metrics and presenting technical validation results to enterprise decision-makers.
* Experience working across product, engineering, sales, and customer teams without losing clarity about technical ownership.
* Startup experience or a record of building repeatable methods from early customer engagements.

A Note from KAVIA

We are not looking for someone who has used every technology or worked in every domain listed above.

We are looking for a strong, hands-on engineer who can earn trust with enterprise customers, bring structure to ambiguous technical work, and stay accountable until the customer has credible evidence. Applicants with demonstrated engineering depth and customer-facing ownership are encouraged to apply, even if their current title is not Customer Solutions Engineer or Forward Deployment Engineer.

How to Apply

* Please apply with your resume and a short note addressing the following: Your current location in India and your ability to maintain regular overlap with US business hours.

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning — to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually — turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us.
  
  
The QA Engineer will be responsible for assuring the quality of our products, creating automated tests, and managing builds and continuous integration. You will automate tests for microservices and their related front ends, and manage infrastructure across development and production cloud environments.
  
  
This role goes beyond conventional application testing. Our platform combines graph data stores, graph analytics, machine learning models, and agentic AI workflows — systems whose outputs are probabilistic, whose correctness is contextual, and whose decisions carry regulatory weight. You will help define what “passing” means for components that don’t return the same answer twice, and build the harnesses that hold them to it.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Core Test Automation**

* Build and maintain end-to-end and component test suites using modern browser automation with auto-waiting, trace-based debugging, and parallel execution as the default
* Shape coverage around the test pyramid rather than the UI — API and contract tests as the primary safety net, with UI reserved for genuine user journeys
* Embed quality gates directly in CI/CD pipelines — sharded parallel runs, risk-based test selection, and pass/fail criteria that block promotion without manual sign-off
* Provision ephemeral, containerised test environments on demand through infrastructure-as-code, with synthetic and masked test data generated per run instead of maintained by hand
* Treat test reliability as a product: track flake rates, quarantine and fix unstable tests, and hold suites to explicit stability and runtime SLAs
* Use AI-assisted tooling for test authoring, coverage gap analysis, and locator resilience — while owning the judgement call on what the generated tests are actually worth
* Work shift-left alongside engineers — contributing test coverage with the feature, not after it — and partner on triage to drive issues to root cause

**Graph Data and Analytics**

* Design and automate validation for graph database layers — schema integrity, relationship correctness, and query behaviour across Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL
* Build regression coverage for graph analytics outputs: pathfinding, centrality, community detection, and link analysis used in fraud-ring identification and network risk scoring
* Validate graph ingestion and transformation pipelines for data completeness, deduplication, and referential accuracy at scale

**AI/ML and Agentic Systems**

* Develop evaluation harnesses for ML model behaviour — accuracy thresholds, drift detection, bias and fairness checks, and explainability outputs required for regulatory review
* Build automated test suites for agentic workflows: tool-calling correctness, multi-step orchestration, context handling, failure recovery, and guardrail enforcement
* Design assertion strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including golden-set comparison, semantic similarity scoring, and LLM-as-judge evaluation
* Establish prompt and model regression testing so behavioural changes are caught before release
* Validate feature pipelines and training/serving consistency in partnership with data science teams

**Process and Platform**

* Incorporate best practices into dev/test/deploy processes and recommend improvements
* Support application onboarding to the defined target operating model to achieve build and release automation
* Document, track, and escalate issues as appropriate

**What’s Required**
**Education:**
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
  
**Experience:**
Proven track record of extensive hands-on experience in automated testing of web applications and services, including designing, developing, and executing automated tests in Python using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent).
  
  
**Qualifications, Strengths And Skills**

* Demonstrated understanding of maintainable test architecture — Page Object Model or equivalent patterns — for end-to-end testing
* Extensive hands-on experience on Python scripting
* Experience testing web services and REST APIs (Postman, Swagger)
* Working knowledge of graph databases — Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, JanusGraph or similar — including writing and validating graph queries
* Exposure to testing AI/ML-backed features, and a clear grasp of why probabilistic systems need different assertions than deterministic ones
* Scripting experience beyond Python: Unix shell, Ruby, or similar
* Continuous integration and pipeline-based delivery (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
* Experience with SQL
* Experience recommending process improvements

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable orchestration tooling
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation tooling and practices: golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, hallucination and jailbreak testing, red-teaming
* Graph analytics libraries such as Neo4j GDS, Apache Spark GraphX, or NetworkX
* Observability-driven testing — synthetic monitoring, canary analysis, and validation through traces, logs and metrics
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible; microservices, container deployment and service orchestration
* Cloud APIs (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* JIRA for issue tracking and escalation

Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, citizenship, or veteran status or medical condition. title: Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Tools Support
description:
Alternate Job Titles
  
  

* EDA Licensing and Installation Support Engineer
* Technical Application Engineer, Licensing Infrastructure
* Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Tools Support
* Licensing and Deployment Applications Engineer
* CAD/EDA Support Engineer, Staff Level

We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years keeping the infrastructure running that everyone else depends on to do their jobs, and you know that when a license server goes down at 3 a.m. in Tokyo, someone's tapeout schedule just became your problem. You are the person who can look at a FlexNet debug log, spot the misconfigured options file or the firewall rule that is blocking port 27000, and have it fixed before the customer finishes explaining what went wrong.
  
  
You do not just troubleshoot, you think in systems. You understand how a three-server redundant licensing setup should behave, why a migration from on-prem to cloud changes the MAC address binding, and what happens when someone upgrades RHEL without testing the environment variables first. You have been in enough customer environments to know that "it worked in dev" means nothing until it works in production.
  
  
You are comfortable talking to a senior CAD engineer about daemon logs and then turning around to explain to a procurement lead why their license count does not match their headcount. You move fast, you document what you learn, and you do not wait for perfect information to start solving the problem. At Synopsys, you will work with global customers who depend on you to keep their design environments operational, and the problems you solve will directly enable the next generation of chips.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Support and troubleshoot Synopsys Common Licensing (SCL) and FlexNet licensing environments for global enterprise customers across Americas, EMEA, Japan, and APAC
* Perform root-cause analysis on complex licensing, installation, deployment, migration, and failover issues, working directly with customer IT, CAD, and engineering teams
* Design, validate, and implement licensing architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments, including three-server redundancy setups and cross-platform configurations
* Lead on-site and remote installation, upgrade, and migration activities for customers deploying or expanding Synopsys EDA toolsets
* Mentor applications engineers and provide technical leadership across support and customer success organizations
* Collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success teams to escalate critical issues, influence product roadmaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable improvements
* Build and maintain technical articles, runbooks, and self-service documentation in the Synopsys Knowledge Base to scale support and reduce resolution time

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Keep customer design environments operational during critical tapeout windows, directly enabling revenue and preventing schedule slips
* Reduce escalation time and resolution cycles for high-priority licensing and deployment issues across Synopsys's largest accounts
* Influence product development by surfacing real-world deployment challenges and customer needs to R&D and product teams
* Scale support effectiveness by creating reusable documentation, automation scripts, and training content that empower frontline engineers and customers
* Strengthen customer relationships by acting as a trusted technical advisor who understands both their infrastructure and their business pressures
* Drive adoption and expansion of Synopsys technologies by ensuring smooth deployments, migrations, and upgrades across diverse customer environments
* Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the broader applications engineering team through knowledge sharing and hands-on collaboration

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or related field with 6+ years of experience, or Master's degree with 4+ years in EDA tool support, CAD/CAE engineering, IT operations, or software application support
* Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration (RHEL, CentOS, SLES), including process management, file permissions, environment variables, and shell scripting
* Hands-on expertise with FlexNet/FLEXlm licensing architecture, including debug logs, options files, daemon configuration, and redundant server setups
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, firewalls, DNS, host IDs, and MAC addresses as they relate to client-server licensing communication
* Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash, Python, Perl, or PowerShell for log parsing, automation, and troubleshooting
* Experience with Windows Server administration for cross-platform EDA tool environments is a plus
* Familiarity with EDA product flows, Synopsys toolsets, or Agentic AI usage is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can walk a customer through a three-server licensing failover scenario and then write a two-paragraph summary for their VP of Engineering without losing the technical thread
* You stay calm under pressure, especially when a licensing issue is blocking a customer's critical milestone and multiple time zones are waiting for your answer
* You think like a detective when diagnosing issues, you do not stop at the symptom, you trace it back to the root cause even if it means digging through daemon logs and network packet captures
* You are detail-oriented and organized enough to manage multiple high-priority escalations across global accounts without dropping threads or missing follow-ups
* You are curious and self-motivated, you do not wait to be told what to learn, you dig into new licensing models, deployment architectures, and automation opportunities on your own
* You value collaboration and knowledge sharing, you document what you learn, mentor others, and contribute to the collective expertise of the team

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of Synopsys's Technical Sales and Applications Engineering organization, which serves as the critical bridge between customers, sales teams, R&D, and product groups. This team is responsible for enabling customers to successfully adopt, deploy, and expand their use of Synopsys EDA technologies while driving revenue growth and operational excellence. You will work closely with global support engineers, customer success teams, and product engineering across multiple regions, and you will have direct visibility into how the infrastructure you support powers the design workflows behind self-driving cars, AI accelerators, 5G chipsets, and the next wave of smart everything.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Detection Engineer – Early Career
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.

Success Measures
  
  

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior AI Engineer
  
  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. In this hands-on role, you'll design, build, and ship production-grade agentic AI systems. These include agents that make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs, handle complex multi-step workflows, and deliver secure, scalable, reliable results. You'll work across agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps, help set the engineering standard for Gen AI development, and mentor other engineers on the team. Much of this work is strong backend engineering. If you bring deep experience building production services and have started building with LLMs, we'd love to
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect and build the tool-calling layer that powers our agents: wrap internal services, data platforms, and external APIs as well-defined tools with clear schemas, contracts, and permissions.
* Engineer reliable tool execution at scale, including parallel and chained tool calls, timeouts, retries, idempotency, error recovery, and graceful handling of tool failures or bad model outputs.
* Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM orchestration, covering async job handling, streaming responses, caching, rate limiting, and distributed workflows supporting high-throughput Gen AI operations.
* Engineer state, memory, and context management subsystems so agents can maintain session continuity across long, multi-step, tool-heavy interactions.
* Architect multi-agent and skills-based agent systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar, enabling autonomous reasoning, tool use, inter-agent coordination, and adaptive decision-making at enterprise scale.
* Build observability for agent behavior, including end-to-end tracing of tool calls, measuring tool-selection accuracy, and debugging multi-step agent runs in production.
* Build retrieval systems (RAG and Graph-RAG) where agents need grounded knowledge, using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Establish LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS), covering MLflow, prompt and agent evaluation, model lineage tracking, CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Design multimodal generative AI pipelines that unify text, image, tabular, and graph data using modern transformer-based and foundation models.
* Guide fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and alignment strategies (e.g., PEFT, LoRA, instruction tuning, RLHF) to adapt foundation models for specialized enterprise use cases, working closely with ML specialists.
* Implement Responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, bias detection, output safety guardrails, explainability, and compliance with data ethics standards.
* Evaluate and productionize advances in agentic AI, multimodal models, and frontier foundation models, benchmarking them against enterprise performance and safety requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, and set the engineering standard for Gen AI development across the program.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* A strong track record of building and operating production backend systems at scale, including distributed services, APIs, async processing, data stores, and observability.
* Strong API design and integration experience: you know how to build services that other systems, and now LLMs, can call safely and reliably.
* Excellent Python engineering skills, including async programming, API development (FastAPI or similar), and microservices, plus SQL proficiency.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one LLM-powered application to production that uses tool/function calling, such as agents that call APIs, query databases, or trigger workflows. This can be with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
* A working understanding of Gen AI engineering patterns, such as prompt design, embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory, or a demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new technical domains.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome).
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, plus strong communication and stakeholder management skills. You should be able to translate technical work into business value.
* Nice to have: experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building tool servers and connectors for LLM agents.
* Nice to have: experience evaluating agent performance, such as tool-selection accuracy, task completion rates, or multi-step reasoning reliability.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, knowledge graphs, or MLOps tooling like MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, or Bedrock.
* Coming from a backend background? We value engineers who take AI from prototype to production as much as those who train the models. If you've built high-throughput systems and started applying those skills to LLM-powered products, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't worked with every tool listed here

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

Oracle’s Automated Patching Framework (APF) builds and delivers software updates for Oracle Database, Exadata, Fleet Patching and Provisioning (FPP), Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle GoldenGate (OGG), Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and Autonomous Health Framework (AHF), across on-premises and cloud environments. APF is a business-critical platform that helps Oracle deliver patches to customers on schedule and improves the efficiency of development teams across the company.
  
  
The framework includes services and tools built with Python, Java, Perl, PL/SQL, and Ant. Our team develops and operates these systems in a large-scale production environment. description:
Senior Java Developer is a position responsible for establishing, designing, and implementing scalable, high-performance application systems and services in close coordination with the Business and Technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to provide strong technical leadership, drive hands-on system analysis and architecture, and lead programming activities to expand and modernize the Onboarding Management & Coordination (OMC) technology platform.
  
  
A key function within Banking and International Clients Technology is the global client onboarding process at Citi. Our team is responsible for the enterprise platform that orchestrates mission-critical client onboarding workflows across multiple business domains, including Legal, Credit, KYC/AML, and Account Opening. We empower clients and operations teams with real-time event-driven information, interactive tools, and robust APIs to automate, streamline, and accelerate end-to-end onboarding lifecycles.
  
  
We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs
* Architect and implement robust event-driven workflows and real-time streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schemas, and fault-tolerant message processing)
* Design and implement highly concurrent, low-latency solutions utilizing advanced multithreading, concurrency patterns, and JVM performance tuning
* Write clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code following modern software engineering best practices, design patterns, and enterprise security standards
* Lead end-to-end SDLC activities from architectural design, technical specification, and implementation through to automated testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, and production deployment
* Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
* Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
* Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve high-impact technical challenges in distributed production environments, leading root-cause analyses and permanent remediation
* Provide technical leadership, establish coding standards, conduct comprehensive peer code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior developers across the team

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise

title: Consultant
description:

Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Embed with customer stakeholders to understand business workflows, constraints, and success metrics; translate ambiguous needs into clear requirements, solution hypotheses, and sprint deliverables for GenAI/agentic scenarios.
* Design and implement agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, M365 Copilots, Power Platform, Azure) including integrations, APIs, and automations that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Prototype rapidly, then harden to production: build POCs for agentic workflows (multi-step tasks, tool-use, orchestration), validate with users, and evolve to production-ready implementations with testing, monitoring, and secure deployment patterns.
* Own end-to-end delivery from architecture through implementation: define build/test specifications, create eval and quality gates for GenAI outputs, and produce operational guides/runbooks for reliability, safety, and maintainability.
* Identify and mitigate business/technical risks specific to AI systems (data access, prompt injection, hallucinations, privacy, compliance, latency, cost); propose safeguards and fallback behaviors for agentic flows.
* Support deployment and live stabilization: troubleshoot integrations and model behavior in real environments, iterate quickly, and ensure successful go-live with clear ownership, monitoring, and incident playbooks.
* Balance platform configuration with extensibility to maximize speed and maintainability. Co-engineer with customer teams to ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, and reusable patterns. Drive delivery plans across the full lifecycle—discovery, build, eval, deployment, and operations—accounting for dependencies across data, security, and enterprise systems.
* Build agentic workflows that invoke tools/APIs safely (function calling patterns), with guardrails, validation, and auditability.
* Implement evaluation strategies (offline/online) to measure output quality, groundedness, safety, and business impact.
* Capture repeatable assets (templates, reference architectures, accelerators) and share feedback loops with internal teams.
* Microsoft 365 Migration & Security — SharePoint Server → SharePoint Online (SP–SPO), Google → Microsoft (GPC–MS). Experienced migration talent especially welcome.
* Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement — Salesforce takeouts (SF Takeout), Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), and standard CE (Sales / Customer Service / Field Service).
* Copilot Extensibility (M365 & D365) — Copilot and Copilot Studio agents, multi-agent (A2A) orchestration, Microsoft Agent Framework and governance, deep expertise in Work IQ (data, memory, inference) and APIs, enterprise data grounding via Graph/D365/connectors.
* Azure Fabric & Azure AI Foundry — One Lake-based unified data management, Lakehouse architecture for analytics and AI, model catalog usage for model discovery and fine-tuning, enterprise agent development and multi-agent orchestration via Foundry Agent Service, data grounding and RAG using One Lake and Azure AI Search.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field AND demonstrated experience delivering production software solutions (or equivalent experience).
* 10+ years’ experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions on Microsoft platforms (Dynamics 365 / M365 Copilot/ Power Platform / Azure), including integration, security, and deployment in customer environments.

**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Proven experience delivering hands‑on, production-grade solutions across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirement ambiguity, development, deployment, and post‑go‑live stabilization.
* Proven delivery of Dynamics 365 CE/Power Platform solutions, M365 Copilot Solutions, plus experience building AI-infused workflows (recommendations, summarization, case routing, contact center assist, sales/service copilots) with production-grade engineering practices.
* Experience building or extending solutions involving Copilots, AI‑assisted workflows, or intelligent automation is a strong plus.
* Certifications and/or experience in Azure Solutions, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot and Power Platform; exposure to Azure AI services and GenAI solution patterns is a strong plus.
* Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and operational readiness (observability, incident response) strongly preferred—especially for AI systems.
* Desirable experience includes Azure solution development, Contact Center solutions, Copilot Studio, and building GenAI/agentic experiences (tool-use orchestration, retrieval grounding, evaluation/quality loops, safety/guardrails).
* Excellent communication: explain AI behaviors, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders; drive alignment from ambiguity to execution.
* Trusted customer-facing engineering presence: collaborate deeply, pair-build with customer teams, and transfer knowledge to ensure long-term maintainability.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks, including AI-specific failure modes (grounding gaps, unsafe outputs, data leakage) and enterprise constraints (security, privacy, compliance).
* IC role: influence without authority through strong engineering judgment, structured problem-solving, and crisp stakeholder communication.

Comfort working across time zones and blended onsite/offshore models; thrives in fast-moving, customer-embedded delivery
  
  
**Success In This Role Includes**

* Delivers working GenAI/agentic solutions from prototype to production with measurable customer impact.
* Implements guardrails and evaluation to ensure reliability, groundedness, safety, and cost/performance targets.
* Leaves behind reusable assets, documentation, and enabled customer teams (no dependency).

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Package Consultant-SAP Application Extensions
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP Application Extensions, you will assist customers in selecting, designing, and implementing SAP applications using innovative approaches such as clean core development. This requires specialized skills in areas like In-App extension, OData, and API Management, as well as strong consulting abilities to collaborate with customers and stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Implement SAP Applications: Design and implement SAP applications using clean core development methodologies, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and meeting customer requirements.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with customers, application stakeholders, and other consultants to understand business needs and deliver tailored solutions that meet their expectations.
* Develop Custom Solutions: Design and develop custom applications using Side by Side application design and development, RAP programming, and embedded Steampunk, leveraging expertise in Complex CDS view design.
* Provide Consulting Expertise: Offer expert guidance and support to customers, helping them navigate the selection and implementation of SAP applications and related technologies.
* Deliver Solution Delivery: Ensure timely and effective delivery of solutions, meeting customer needs and expectations while adhering to project timelines and budgets.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to SAP Application Development: Experience working with SAP applications, including design, implementation, and integration with existing systems.
* In-App Extension and API Management: Familiarity with In-App extension, OData, and API Management, with ability to apply these skills in a consulting context.
* Complex CDS View Design: Understanding of Complex CDS view design principles and ability to apply them in custom application development.
* Side by Side Application Development: Experience with Side by Side application design and development, RAP programming, and embedded Steampunk.
* Consulting and Collaboration: Exposure to consulting environments, working closely with customers, stakeholders, and other consultants to deliver tailored solutions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Advanced SAP Application Knowledge: Exposure to SAP application development, including design, implementation, and integration with existing systems, is beneficial for this role. Familiarity with SAP's latest technologies and trends would be an asset.
* Specialized Technical Skills: Knowledge of specialized skills like In-App extension, OData, API Management, Complex CDS view design, Side by Side application design and development, RAP programming, and embedded Steampunk would be advantageous in delivering high-quality solutions.
* Consulting Expertise: Prior experience working in a consulting environment, collaborating with customers, stakeholders, and other consultants to deliver tailored solutions, would be valuable in this position.
